assumptions.label: S$ shown are addressable, before conversion: drop-off = the account's last-12-month value at risk, cross-sell = the yearly gap to similar customers. Multiply by the assumed rate for an expected value. Rates are team assumptions, below the 25–30% tender win rate in our research. Never summed into a revenue headline.

crossSell.name: Hospital Daerah Desa Perdana
crossSell.reason: Runs our analyser (QTS), yet buys only S$44k of test kits (A) a year. Similar public hospitals in Malaysia with our analyser spend S$3.4 on kits per S$1 of consumables; at its S$65k of consumables, that is S$224k. The reagents are probably bought elsewhere. Its reagent-rental contract ended Feb 2026 and kit orders stopped after Jan 2026: a win-back at the next tender, not a quick sale.
crossSell.signalSource: cross-sell: installed-base pull-through (C installed, low A)

method.dropOff: Per merged customer x product (A, B). Trend = Apr–Sep 2026 vs Apr–Sep 2025; slope = OLS on the last 12 months after removing the country x product seasonal index; recency = days since last PO at 30 Sep 2026 vs the median gap between order dates. Flag if S$10k+ a year earlier, still ordering, and (trend <= −25% with a falling slope) or (overdue by 1.5x the usual gap with trend <= −10%). S$ at risk = last-12-month value.
method.crossSell: Peer gap within country and segment (region-wide if fewer than 4 peers), sized to the customer: expected = own spend on the anchor product x peers' median ratio, capped at the peers' 90th percentile. B gap: anchor A, flag if B is below 30% of expected and the gap is S$15k+. Installed-base pull-through (C installed, low A): anchor B among peers with our analyser, flag if A is below 50% of expected and the gap is S$15k+. A signal only; never a forecast feature (no leakage).
method.productC: Product C (instruments) is tender-driven and planned from the PR/tender pipeline, not flagged here.

rawViewCheck.description: The same pre-registered rules run on raw SAP records (no merging). 'hidden' = flagged on golden IDs but on no single record; 'false' = flagged on a record but not on the merged customer.
